about_the_game:
Welcome to the underground arena, where chaos meets competition.

You're on a mission, dig through destructible caves packed with minerals, power-ups, and rival moles.

Mine resources, outsmart your opponents, and deposit your minerals in this fast-paced party brawler for 2–8 players.

Fight, blast, and jetpack your way through frantic matches as you race to fill the cart—but watch out, rivals will do anything to steal your haul.

Dig & Destroy

Tunnel through dynamic, randomly generated maps where no two matches are the same. Shape the battlefield as you dig, fight, and sabotage your way to victory.

Build Your Loadout, Your Way

Mix and match unique tools, gadgets. Master your favorite combo or counter your friends' strategies.

Chaotic PvP Multiplayer

Battle up to seven other moles in free-for-all or team-based brawls online. Outplay, out-smart, and out-mine your rivals in unpredictable underground arenas.

Built for Party Play

Grab a controller and jump into fast-paced online matches with friends, bots or strangers. Mineral Madness supports full controller setups.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130, AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960, AMD R9 380, Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400, AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060, AMD RX 480, Intel Arc A580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Dig, fight, and sabotage your way to victory in a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler! Battle other moles in wild, random caves, build your loadout, and deposit your minerals to win.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Traditional Chinese
